note: The Bristol Trading Competition on /books/competition/ (js/books-comp.js). The trading week is scored from each book's daily account values in books/data/<book>.json. Pitch: add up each desk's marks from all the judges' scorecards (/roadmap/competition/scorecard/) and enter them in "pitchMarks", keyed by book id: { "ficc-aled": { "total": 214, "thesis": 36, "analysis": 33 } }. Desks are placed by total (ties split by thesis, then analysis) and earn points from "pitchPoints", the trading week's table times 65/35, rounded, so the week counts for 35% and the pitch for 65%. A number in "pitch" sets a desk's pitch points directly instead. Set "final": true once every team's export to the last day is in. Results (places and points) stay hidden until "reveal": true; add ?preview=1 to the page address to check them before then. The Floor hides every book's figures until floorRevealAt (UTC; 20:00 is 8 pm in the UK in November) or reveal, whichever comes first.
